versions.content: A static status variable, denoting whether a BSW module is initialized, should be initialized with value 0 before any APIs of the BSW module are called. The initialization function of the BSW modules will set the static status variable to a value not equa l to 0. This variable is used to check if the module has been initialized before calling an API.
